levelling.note: A skill needs (base + level * perLevel) use-points to rise one level. Each skill increase adds the new skill level to character XP; the character levels when XP reaches (level + 2) * levelStep.

skills.name: One-Handed
skills.desc: Swords, axes and daggers held in one hand. Raised by striking with them.

perks.name: Armsman
perks.desc: One-handed weapons do 20% more damage.

perks.name: Fighting Stance
perks.desc: Power attacks cost 25% less stamina.

perks.name: Savage Strike
perks.desc: Power attacks do 25% more damage.

perks.name: Armsman II
perks.desc: One-handed weapons do a further 20% more damage.

perks.name: Paralyzing Strike
perks.desc: Power attacks stagger even large foes.

skills.name: Block
skills.desc: Turning blows aside with a shield or blade. Raised by blocking hits.

perks.name: Shield Wall
perks.desc: Blocking is 20% more effective.

perks.name: Deflect Arrows
perks.desc: Arrows that hit your block do no damage.

perks.name: Quick Reflexes
perks.desc: A well-timed block staggers the attacker.

perks.name: Elemental Ward
perks.desc: Blocking halves fire damage.

skills.name: Archery
skills.desc: The bow. Raised by hitting targets with arrows.

perks.name: Overdraw
perks.desc: Bows do 20% more damage.

perks.name: Eagle Eye
perks.desc: Hold block while drawn to zoom in.

perks.name: Steady Hand
perks.desc: Draw the bow 30% faster.

perks.name: Overdraw II
perks.desc: Bows do a further 20% more damage.

skills.name: Destruction
skills.desc: Spells that burn and break. Raised by damaging foes with them.

perks.name: Novice Destruction
perks.desc: Novice destruction spells cost half as much magicka.

perks.name: Augmented Flames
perks.desc: Fire spells do 25% more damage.

perks.name: Intense Flames
perks.desc: Foes at low health flee from fire.

perks.name: Augmented Flames II
perks.desc: Fire spells do a further 25% more damage.

skills.name: Restoration
skills.desc: Mending flesh. Raised by healing wounds.

perks.name: Novice Restoration
perks.desc: Novice restoration spells cost half as much magicka.

perks.name: Regeneration
perks.desc: Healing spells cure 50% more.

perks.name: Recovery
perks.desc: Magicka regenerates 25% faster.

perks.name: Respite
perks.desc: Healing spells also restore stamina.

skills.name: Sneak
skills.desc: Moving unseen. Raised by staying hidden near those who would see you.

perks.name: Stealth
perks.desc: You are 20% harder to detect while sneaking.

perks.name: Backstab
perks.desc: Sneak attacks with one-handed weapons do 6x damage.

perks.name: Deadly Aim
perks.desc: Sneak attacks with bows do 3x damage.

perks.name: Muffled Movement
perks.desc: Moving makes half as much noise.

skills.name: Lockpicking
skills.desc: Opening what was meant to stay shut. Raised by picking locks.

perks.name: Novice Locks
perks.desc: Novice and apprentice locks are much easier to pick.

perks.name: Quick Hands
perks.desc: Picking a lock never gets you noticed.

perks.name: Steady Pick
perks.desc: Lockpicks break half as often.

skills.name: Speech
skills.desc: Bargaining, persuading and threatening. Raised by trading and by winning arguments.

perks.name: Haggling
perks.desc: Buying and selling prices are 10% better.

perks.name: Persuasion
perks.desc: Persuasion attempts are 30% easier.

perks.name: Intimidation
perks.desc: Intimidation attempts are twice as likely to work.

perks.name: Haggling II
perks.desc: Prices are a further 10% better.

skills.name: Alchemy
skills.desc: Brewing potions at an alchemy table. Raised by making them.

perks.name: Alchemist
perks.desc: Potions you make are 20% stronger.

perks.name: Physician
perks.desc: Restoring potions are 25% stronger.

perks.name: Experimenter
perks.desc: Eating an ingredient reveals all of its effects.

perks.name: Alchemist II
perks.desc: Potions you make are a further 20% stronger.

skills.name: Smithing
skills.desc: Forging weapons and armour. Raised by making them at a forge.

perks.name: Iron Smithing
perks.desc: You can forge iron at a forge.

perks.name: Steel Smithing
perks.desc: You can forge steel, and steel items you make are 10% better.

perks.name: Arcane Temper
perks.desc: Weapons and armour you forge are 20% better.
